technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with bullish moving average alignment and momentum crossovers, but overbought conditions (RSI-21, Stoch, Williams %R) and negative CMF create elevated pullback risk; suitable for swing entry only with tight stops or on dips.

fundamental.summary: ANET shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 91 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with bearish market sentiment (47% bearish vs 25% bullish) offset by neutral fear/greed reading; congressional activity minimal and non-directional with small-amount junior member trades only.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (271.68) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 91 days poses minimal near-term binary risk but macro environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish MACD and Stoch crossovers provides technical uptrend structure suitable for swing entry on dips toward 31.56 support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought technicals (RSI-21, Stoch 81.18, Williams %R), negative CMF, zero fundamental catalysts, weak smart-money alignment, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) create asymmetric downside risk far exceeding upside potential.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical uptrend structure with price above major moving averages and bullish MACD crossover provides framework for swing entry. However, overbought conditions (RSI-21, Stoch 81.18) at resistance with negative CMF signal weak accumulation and elevated pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 271.68) combined with zero fundamental catalysts, weak smart-money alignment, and overbought technicals create asymmetric downside risk that far exceeds swing trade upside potential.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro environment and weak fundamental support outweighing technical strength
